recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中數顆大型細胞具有豐富、圓形、淡灰紫色的胞質，核被推向一側呈腎形或新月形，與周圍的顆粒球及淋巴球相比明顯大很多，符合增生的組織球（reactive histiocytosis）。
features: Several large histiocytes with abundant round, pale gray-lilac, finely granular cytoplasm
Eccentric reniform, crescentic or indented nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Low N:C ratio; no obvious phagocytosed cells or organisms in the cytoplasm
Background of granulocytic precursors, bands, small lymphocytes and erythroid cells
Linear fiber-like artifact crossing the field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several large histiocytes with abundant round, pale gray-lilac, finely granular cytoplasm and eccentric reniform to crescentic nuclei. The histiocytes do not contain identifiable phagocytosed hematopoietic cells, organisms or pigment at this magnification. The background contains maturing granulocytic cells, small lymphocytes and erythroid precursors without an increase in blasts, and a linear fiber artifact crosses the field. Findings are consistent with reactive histiocytosis; evaluation for hemophagocytosis, infection, storage disease and systemic inflammatory causes is suggested.

ddx.vs: HLH requires histiocytes containing ingested erythrocytes, platelets or nucleated cells together with clinical criteria, which are not evident here.
Gaucher-type cells have fibrillary 'wrinkled paper' blue-gray cytoplasm rather than homogeneous finely granular pale cytoplasm.
Monoblasts are smaller cells with fine immature chromatin, nucleoli and higher N:C ratio, present in increased numbers.
Tumor cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear atypia and high N:C ratio rather than dispersed bland histiocytes.
